import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Check what we have in dist that works
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls /opt/areloria/server/dist/core/*.js 2>&1 | head -10")
print("Core files:", stdout.read().decode())
# Run a simpler test - can we import any core modules?
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria/server && node -e \"import('./dist/index.js').catch(e=>console.log('FAIL:',e.message))\" 2>&1 | head -5")
print("\nTest import:", stdout.read().decode())
# Check if there's an alternative entry
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls /opt/areloria/server/dist/app.js 2>&1")
print("\nApp:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
